pull.title: test: Update BIP324 test vectors
pull.body: This updates the hardcoded test vectors from BIP324. The test vectors had to be regenerated (in the aux files of the BIP) because there was a bug in the script used for generating them (https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/pull/2016).
